comment: Recorded from managed by ServiceControlRuntimeTests.NativeLowPowerTriggerVectors; regenerate with OPENBLADE_REGENERATE_NATIVE_PROFILE_VECTORS. A lowPower row runs with the LowPowerGate entered. A report row whose expect has transition true ran ApplyFullTransitionAsync with the gate clear. setters counts the device setters the request submitted. startup is ApplyFullTransitionAsync itself, as the user's profile load runs it; writeBlock is ScopedThermalWriteBlockReason, which every thermal write of a transition checks. An explicit row is a persistent override at power, the pluggedIn rows first, then the battery rows after a source change with the gate clear.
